vulnerability_type: Unsafe Ether Transfer leads to DoS

preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract to execute the exploit.
The target contract must have a non-zero BNB balance for the Sweep function to be meaningful.

exploit_hint: The exploit involves the owner transferring ownership to a malicious contract designed to block fund withdrawals. First, deploy an attacker contract with a receive() fallback function that consumes more than the 2300 gas stipend provided by .transfer(). As the current EOA owner, call transferOwnership() on the target contract, passing the address of the newly deployed attacker contract. Then, trigger the Sweep() function through the attacker contract. The call to Sweep() will pass the onlyOwner modifier but will revert when attempting to transfer the BNB balance, as the attacker contract's fallback will run out of gas. This permanently locks the BNB balance within the target contract, as the owner is now a contract incapable of receiving the funds via the Sweep function.
